notes.title: Update 1.1.2 Now Available
notes.notes:
[u][b]What's New?[/b][/u]
 
- Customizable arcade area including walls, brick, neon, and flooring.
- Go-Kart Time Trials Raceway
- New Games- Pop Off, Half Court Smash
- Lil Rocker Ride-On
- Token to Cash Converter
- 5 Additional Achievements

[b][u]Core Improvements[/u][/b]
- Motion Blur Toggle
- FOV Slider
- Adjustable Walk Speed
- Ability To Sprint *Speed scales according to Walk Speed
- Right Click Zooming

[b][u]Additional Game Improvements[/u][/b]
- Conveyor ball return system for 2 Minute Warning
- Adjustable Power for Rocket Roller
- Ticket payout increased for basketball
- Token Pushers spawn in more tokens additional to bonus ticket prizes
- Guide rails on Hurricane to improve stability and help prevent stacking
- Swinging dividers for Penguin Bowler, increased ticket payout
- Improved accuracy and prize indicator lighting on Hook, Line, & Tickets

notes.title: Early Look At What's Coming in the 1.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
I realize it seems we have gone radio silent the past few weeks so I figured its only fair to give you guys an early look at what's to come in 1.1.2.  Please be patient as this is a very large update, and still has a ways to go.

[b][u]Additions to Core Functionality and Navigation[/u][/b]
-FOV Slider in Settings
-Right Click Zooming(works while free roaming in addition to being available while playing most games).  Also the zoom mechanic auto adapts according to the settings of your FOV.
-Left Shift Sprint Added to aid with efficiently navigating the new larger complex.

[b][u]Improvements to Existing Games[/u][/b]
-Lighting effects added to 2 Minute Warning as well as a new conveyor system ball return which performs much cleaner than the respawn system.
-Win lighting effects added to Hurricane as well as guide rails for "traffic control" to make for considerably better respawning after a win.  Also issues with cones glitching through the table surface and disappearing have been drastically reduced.
-Elevated jackpot platform added to Mega Drop In to better balance the game and closer emulate it's real counterpart.
-Penguin Bowler now introduces a back and forth sweeping pattern to the value slots to add to the challenge of playing.  This is a step away from it's real counterpart, but it's considerably more fun to play.  Max ticket payout also bumped up to 150 from the original 60. 
-EZ Drop has been taken a step further by introducing reverse bucket rotation mid game to add to the challenge.

[u][b]Multi-Level Complex to House Everything[/b][/u]
-There are in total 5 floor levels to explore in the new building.
-Everyone likes options and have their own tastes, so the the new complex is fully customizable.  You'll be able to tailor your own experience with 2 adjustable settings for the walls, 2 settings to control both sets of neon, and ability to change the flooring.  These appearance settings can be changed at any time on the fly from within the arcade by accessing the the control box located in the entry hallway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751827/38a2db6a3c693982f0ffbd9853279eb1633c7f48.png[/img]

[u][b]Ladies and Gentleman...Start Your Engines[/b][/u]
-1.1.2 will also introduce the Domination 300 Speedway.  This new addition will feature a time trials/attack system with rewards in the form of both tickets and cold hard arcade cash for record breaking numbers.  This has been a huge focal point the past few weeks, tweaking and dialing in the go-kart...which by the way is equipped with nitrous and can reach speeds around 45mph on the straightaways.  The track itself is shaped like a music note and has banking corners in the rounds of the note.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751827/01be89ccf6ae5d716595252db0c1dd7e431cb024.png[/img]

[u][b]Who's The Bright, Smiling New Faces?[/b][/u]
-Toby(left) will be running the newly added snack bar and present various new powerup options for you to purchase.  I don't foresee any issues with his pending background screening :)
-Otto(right) will be making sure you put family last at the new speedway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751827/2cad243645450d3ddec5494e3900238a0fa0347d.png[/img]

[u][b]...And Most Importantly![/b][/u]
A lot of players have expressed a serious dislike for the lack of ability to flush the toilet in their house so now that functionality has also been added as well.

[u][b]Conclusion[/b][/u]
One thing to keep in mind guys is this is just a list of things we already have in place and ready.  Much more is slated to be completed before releasing.  We also have several new games to introduce, some complete, some still in prototyping and we'll announce them at a later date.  Serious consideration was given about breaking the update into pieces but did not want to ship a building that was half empty, which could obviously be very confusing to new owners playing for the first time.   Really appreciate all the support and feedback we have been getting and just know we are working diligently to get you more content.  It'll be worth the wait.

notes.title: Updates for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[u]Hotfixes[/u]
-Audio Sliders Resetting back to default after adjusting.
-Conflict with VR headsets causing game not to display on monitor correctly.
-Ticket payouts not doubling on Brains Galore when using powerup.
-Slow or no coin rolling on Token Rocker.
-Money To Burn Achievement Not Unlocking after reaching/surpassing $200 while playing Major League 
 Cash.

[u]Improvements [/u]
-Letter indicators in camera range of player on Brains Galore to better track which ones are needed for a jackpot.
-More precise win zone on Brains Galore.
-More precise win zone on Hook, Line, & Tickets.
-Audio Levels Rebalanced.
-Tubecubes prizes have improved collision for more precise and cleaner grabs.

notes.title: Upcoming Update targeted for 7/15/21
notes.notes:
Just a heads up of an upcoming update that we're hoping to roll out Thursday 7/15/21.  The list of planned hotfixes and improvements are the following.

-Game not displaying correctly when a VR headset is plugged into the computer.  
(If you are experiencing this issue currently, simply unplug your VR headset before launching the game as a temporary solution until patched.  This game does not and will not in the foreseeable future support VR.)

-Token Rocker not spawning tokens and/or rolling extremely slow resulting in the player getting stuck on the machine, forcing a restart of the game.

-Ticket payouts not doubling on Brains Galore while using a Moist powerup.

-Money To Burn Achievement not unlocking while reaching or exceeding $200 Arcade Cash while playing Major League Cash.  (A workaround to get the achievement after surpassing $200 is to win on a single round of Run For Roses with any wager amount.)

-Rebalancing of all default audio Levels, including the unintentional "jump scare" logo and landing screens :)

-Audio sliders resetting back to default positions upon entering the arcade after adjusting from the landing screen.

On a side note, we all want more games to choose from...and they are coming soon!

And just for fun...
We began to gather video clips capturing live streamers reactions of their first time to the player's house, more specifically the bathroom and they are absolute gold!  We can't catch them all unfortunately, so please send or link us to any you come across, as we'd love to make a compilation video!
